description: Get official European Central Bank reference exchange rates for ~33 fiat currencies (Frankfurter/ECB)

base.description: Base currency code, uppercase (e.g. "USD", "EUR"). ~33 ECB currencies.

currencies.description: Filter to specific target currencies (e.g. ["EUR","GBP"]). Omit for all ECB currencies.

date.description: Historical date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit for latest ECB rates.

name: finance.currency.ecb

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Get ECB Exchange Rates
